build_humanoid_soccer_walker: build a Humanoid soccer walker with JERSEY visual mode and a specific walker_id and marker_rgba
add_visual_only_geoms: add visual-only geoms like elbows and knees to a MuJoCo MJCF root to complement the JERSEY visual
get_marker_geoms: get the sequence of marker geoms on a Humanoid walker that should be colored visually
apply_action_to_humanoid: apply an action to a Humanoid walker physics state and update the stored previous action
initialize_humanoid_episode: initialize a new episode for a Humanoid walker by resetting the previous action to zeros
